name: Kohl's Senior & Military Discounts
description: 15% off in-store purchases (Wednesdays for 60+, Mondays for military)
fullDescription: Kohl's offers 15% off in-store purchases for seniors (60+) every Wednesday and for military/veterans every Monday with valid verification.
whatTheyOffer:
- 15% off qualifying in-store purchases for seniors 60+ every Wednesday
- 15% off qualifying in-store purchases for military every Monday
- Military discount covers active duty, veterans, retirees, and their immediate family
- In store only (not valid online); some items excluded
- Cannot be combined with other percent-off coupons, including the other age or military discount
howToGetIt:
1. Seniors: Visit a Kohl's store on Wednesday and bring ID showing you are 60 or older
2. Military: Visit a Kohl's store on Monday with a military ID, a state ID showing veteran status, or a DD 214
3. Tell the cashier you qualify before checking out
keywords: Kohl's, senior discount, military discount, veteran, 60+, Wednesday, Monday, retail, department store, 15% off
